collection.source_revision_note: Patent publications are cited by publication number and retrieval date, not by repository revision; every record carries its own publication URL.
collection.redistribution: MIT for the transcription, the Project and the evidence extract; the patent documents are not redistributed

hashing.source_input_sha256: SHA-256 of the transcribed prescription text as the evidence extract stores it, UTF-8, LF line endings
hashing.project_sha256: SHA-256 of the committed project.json file's bytes, UTF-8, LF line endings, one trailing newline
hashing.record_hash: SHA-256 over the record's JSON with record_hash and record_hash_method removed: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) as UTF-8, no trailing newline

input_inventory.basis: every published numerical example the batch considered: one row per example whether or not it became a record
input_inventory.note: The candidate inventory below is the full-frame screening list the selection was made from; it is larger than the input inventory because the batch takes a sample of it.

candidate_inventory.screening_rule: full frame: the printed image height is 20.9 to 21.8 mm, the 35 mm frame half diagonal being 21.63 mm
candidate_inventory.position_note: `table_position` is the order of the numerical-example table in the document as the screening parser found it, not necessarily the article's own example number; every committed record states the article's number in its title and source reference.

outcomes.source_input: US20250231376A1, Surface Data and Various Data tables, third numerical example

outcomes.source_input: US20260140424A1, Surface Data and Various Data tables, fourth numerical example
outcomes.reason: The printed table has two negative air spacings, d7 = -0.03 mm and d33 = -0.06 mm. The importer refuses any non-positive thickness (THICKNESS_INVALID: surfaces follow each other along +Z) and the numbers may not be altered. The negatives are part of the printed design rather than a reading error: with them the tabulated thicknesses sum to the printed overall lens length of 176.52 mm exactly, and to 176.61 mm if they are zeroed. The transcription is kept; its paraxial first order is 97.206 mm EFL with a 21.63 mm chief-ray image height.

outcomes.source_input: US20260186266A1, Surface Data and Various Data tables, first numerical example, wide-angle end
outcomes.reason: The prescription is verified at all three zoom positions (paraxial EFL 24.723 / 61.316 / 116.364 mm against the printed 24.72 / 61.33 / 116.36; track 178.46 / 191.25 / 204.03 against 178.45 / 191.24 / 204.02; engine back focus 14.685 against the printed 14.59), and the build passes every other gate. The printed wide-angle half field of 37.12 deg traces to a 16.774 mm image height, i.e. a 33.55 mm image circle against the printed 43.28 mm frame, so a record would claim a full-frame format the model does not deliver. The publication's own rows show why: its middle and telephoto half angles are exactly atan(21.64/f) while the wide one is not. Examples 2 and 3 of the same publication show the same pattern at their wide ends.

outcomes.source_input: US20260194764A1, Surface Data and Various Data tables, fifth numerical example
outcomes.reason: Same construction as the fourth example of the same publication: a folded transmissive-reflective prism, which the sequential surface table cannot represent.

outcomes.source_input: US20260194764A1, Surface Data and Various Data tables, fourth numerical example
outcomes.reason: The example folds the beam through a transmissive-reflective prism, so its surface table contains a reflecting surface. The sequential csv-surface-table/1 format the importer reads describes a single forward pass along +Z and cannot express a fold or the reversed propagation after it.

outcomes.source_input: US20260202717A1, Surface Data and Various Data tables, eleventh numerical example
outcomes.reason: The publication's asphere formula carries odd orders as well as even ones (X = (1/R)H^2/(1+sqrt(1-(1+k)(H/R)^2)) + sum A_i |H|^i for i = 3..14), and surfaces 3, 4, 22 and 23 each print A3, A5 and A7. csv-surface-table/1 admits a4 to a18 only, so the import refuses the column. The odd terms cannot be dropped: at the clear aperture they move surface 3 by 5.69 mm and surface 4 by 11.13 mm of sag, and without them surface 4 is not defined over its aperture. The transcription itself is verified (EFL 20.481 against 20.48, back focus 22.156 against 22.15, both pupils to 0.02 mm).

outcomes.source_input: US20260202717A1, Surface Data and Various Data tables, first numerical example
outcomes.reason: The transcription is verified six ways (paraxial EFL 14.4214 against the printed 14.42; back focus 12.6073 against 12.62; entrance pupil 18.884 against 18.88; exit pupil -149.42 against -149.28; lens-unit focal lengths and unit lengths all to 0.01 mm). The importer nevertheless refuses the table because the clear apertures are derived from a paraxial chief ray at 56.32 deg, which overstates the ray height by 25 to 50 per cent in this negative front group: the derived radius of surface 2 is 26.45 mm against its vertex radius of 22.391 mm. The publication prints an effective diameter for every surface (18.78 mm semi-diameter at surface 2), and with those the import succeeds at an EFL fraction of 0.013, but the toolchain cannot yet take transcribed semi-diameters. The example would also fail the field gate: the traced corner is 18.96 mm, since the printed half field is nominal atan(21.64/f).

outcomes.source_input: US20260259392A1, Surface Data and Various Data tables, first embodiment, infinite-conjugate column
outcomes.reason: The prescription is verified (paraxial EFL 87.912 against the printed 87.89; all five printed lens-unit focal lengths reproduce to 0.01 mm; total length and back focus agree), but the traced chief ray at the printed 13.83 deg half field lands at 25.17 mm, i.e. a 50.34 mm image circle against the printed 43.28 mm. The distortion curve is smooth in field (0.5 / 1.9 / 5.1 / 16.3 per cent at 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7 / 1.0 of the field), so the corner value is the prescription's own pincushion and not a transcription error; a record would overstate the format by 16 per cent.

outcomes.source_input: US20260287867A1, Surface Data and Various Data tables, first numerical example, wide-angle end
outcomes.reason: The prescription is confirmed by the paraxial EFL of all three columns (28.804 / 49.007 / 67.900 against the printed 28.80 / 49.00 / 67.90) and by the printed back focus (15.39 / 26.31 / 34.87 reproduced exactly), and the telephoto end of the same example is committed. At the printed wide-angle half field of 34.93 deg the traced chief ray lands at 18.77 mm, i.e. a 37.54 mm image circle against 43.28 mm. Tracing at the frame-corner angle atan(21.64 / 28.80) = 36.92 deg returns exactly 20.10 mm, so the printed wide-angle field is computed from the design's own corner height of 20.10 mm while the table prints the nominal 21.64 mm.
